name: @parallelogram-js/dashboard
description: A BEM-style CSS dashboard library inspired by shadcn/ui

scripts.build: sass scss/main.scss dist/parallelogram-dashboard.css && sass scss/demo-pages.scss demo/css/demo.css --no-source-map && cp dist/parallelogram-dashboard.css demo/css/parallelogram-dashboard.css && npm run build:min && npm run vendor && npm run llms
scripts.build:min: sass scss/main.scss dist/parallelogram-dashboard.min.css --style=compressed --no-source-map && lightningcss --minify dist/parallelogram-dashboard.min.css -o dist/parallelogram-dashboard.min.css
scripts.vendor: rm -rf demo/vendor && mkdir -p demo/vendor && rsync -a --exclude dev --exclude types --exclude '*.map' node_modules/@parallelogram-js/core/dist/ demo/vendor/parallelogram-js/ && rsync -a src/js/ demo/vendor/parallelogram-dashboard/

author: PeptoLab
